mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate level is inversely related to equity returns; a lower current value of FEDFUNDS predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is always active and uses the current level of FEDFUNDS without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: The Rank IC of the FEDFUNDS level (as a continuous variable) with respect to 20-day forward returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that triggers a flight to quality and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and a high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals an accommodative monetary policy response to a weak labor market, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (FEDFUNDS < 0.5 AND UNRATE > 5.0) fails to produce positive returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC of the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (defined as FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days are negative due to reduced liquidity and higher discount rates.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5.

mechanism_narrative: The current level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) is positively correlated with equity returns; a higher current value of PAYEMS predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. The signal is always active and uses the current level of PAYEMS without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: The Rank IC of the PAYEMS level (as a continuous variable) with respect to 60-day forward returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 550.0 thousand units, it signals a weakening housing market that triggers a flight to quality and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 550.0.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 90 and retail sales (RSAFS) rises above 350,000 million dollars, it indicates a resilient consumer sector despite weak industrial output, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (INDPRO < 90 AND RSAFS > 350000.0) fails to produce positive returns in more than 60% of instances, or the Rank IC of the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion (defined as GDP growth above 13200 billion dollars), the S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days are negative due to overvaluation and increased risk of policy tightening.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 > 13200.0.
